verses.ar: وَٱفْتَقَدَ ٱلرَّبُّ سَارَةَ كَمَا قَالَ، وَفَعَلَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِسَارَةَ كَمَا تَكَلَّمَ.
verses.kjv: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
verses.web: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.

verses.ar: فَحَبِلَتْ سَارَةُ وَوَلَدَتْ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ ٱبْنًا فِي شَيْخُوخَتِهِ، فِي ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلَّذِي تَكَلَّمَ ٱللهُ عَنْهُ.
verses.kjv: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.web: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

verses.ar: وَدَعَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ ٱسْمَ ٱبْنِهِ ٱلْمَوْلُودِ لَهُ، ٱلَّذِي وَلَدَتْهُ لَهُ سَارَةُ «إِسْحَاقَ».
verses.kjv: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
verses.web: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

verses.ar: وَخَتَنَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ إِسْحَاقَ ٱبْنَهُ وَهُوَ ٱبْنُ ثَمَانِيَةِ أَيَّامٍ كَمَا أَمَرَهُ ٱللهُ.
verses.kjv: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.web: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ٱبْنَ مِئَةِ سَنَةٍ حِينَ وُلِدَ لَهُ إِسْحَاقُ ٱبْنُهُ.
verses.kjv: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
verses.web: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

verses.ar: وَقَالَتْ سَارَةُ: «قَدْ صَنَعَ إِلَيَّ ٱللهُ ضِحْكًا. كُلُّ مَنْ يَسْمَعُ يَضْحَكُ لِي».
verses.kjv: ¶ And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, [so that] all that hear will laugh with me.
verses.web: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

verses.ar: وَقَالَتْ: «مَنْ قَالَ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ: سَارَةُ تُرْضِعُ بَنِينَ؟ حَتَّى وَلَدْتُ ٱبْنًا فِي شَيْخُوخَتِهِ!».
verses.kjv: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born [him] a son in his old age.
verses.web: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

verses.ar: فَكَبِرَ ٱلْوَلَدُ وَفُطِمَ. وَصَنَعَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَلِيمَةً عَظِيمَةً يَوْمَ فِطَامِ إِسْحَاقَ.
verses.kjv: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the [same] day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.web: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

verses.ar: وَرَأَتْ سَارَةُ ٱبْنَ هَاجَرَ ٱلْمِصْرِيَّةِ ٱلَّذِي وَلَدَتْهُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ يَمْزَحُ،
verses.kjv: ¶ And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
verses.web: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

verses.ar: فَقَالَتْ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ: «ٱطْرُدْ هَذِهِ ٱلْجَارِيَةَ وَٱبْنَهَا، لِأَنَّ ٱبْنَ هَذِهِ ٱلْجَارِيَةِ لَا يَرِثُ مَعَ ٱبْنِي إِسْحَاقَ».
verses.kjv: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, [even] with Isaac.
verses.web: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

verses.ar: فَقَبُحَ ٱلْكَلَامُ جِدًّا فِي عَيْنَيْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لِسَبَبِ ٱبْنِهِ.
verses.kjv: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son.
verses.web: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ ٱللهُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ: «لَا يَقْبُحُ فِي عَيْنَيْكَ مِنْ أَجْلِ ٱلْغُلَامِ وَمِنْ أَجْلِ جَارِيَتِكَ. فِي كُلِّ مَا تَقُولُ لَكَ سَارَةُ ٱسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهَا، لِأَنَّهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ يُدْعَى لَكَ نَسْلٌ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.web: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.

verses.ar: وَٱبْنُ ٱلْجَارِيَةِ أَيْضًا سَأَجْعَلُهُ أُمَّةً لِأَنَّهُ نَسْلُكَ».
verses.kjv: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he [is] thy seed.
verses.web: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”

verses.ar: فَبَكَّرَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ صَبَاحًا وَأَخَذَ خُبْزًا وَقِرْبَةَ مَاءٍ وَأَعْطَاهُمَا لِهَاجَرَ، وَاضِعًا إِيَّاهُمَا عَلَى كَتِفِهَا، وَٱلْوَلَدَ، وَصَرَفَهَا. فَمَضَتْ وَتَاهَتْ فِي بَرِّيَّةِ بِئْرِ سَبْعٍ.
verses.kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave [it] unto Hagar, putting [it] on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.
verses.web: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا فَرَغَ ٱلْمَاءُ مِنَ ٱلْقِرْبَةِ طَرَحَتِ ٱلْوَلَدَ تَحْتَ إِحْدَى ٱلْأَشْجَارِ،
verses.kjv: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
verses.web: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.

verses.ar: وَمَضَتْ وَجَلَسَتْ مُقَابِلَهُ بَعِيدًا نَحْوَ رَمْيَةِ قَوْسٍ، لِأَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: «لَا أَنْظُرُ مَوْتَ ٱلْوَلَدِ». فَجَلَسَتْ مُقَابِلَهُ وَرَفَعَتْ صَوْتَهَا وَبَكَتْ.
verses.kjv: And she went, and sat her down over against [him] a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against [him], and lift up her voice, and wept.
verses.web: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

verses.ar: فَسَمِعَ ٱللهُ صَوْتَ ٱلْغُلَامِ، وَنَادَى مَلَاكُ ٱللهِ هَاجَرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ وَقَالَ لَهَا: «مَا لَكِ يَا هَاجَرُ؟ لَا تَخَافِي، لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ قَدْ سَمِعَ لِصَوْتِ ٱلْغُلَامِ حَيْثُ هُوَ.
verses.kjv: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he [is].
verses.web: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

verses.ar: قُومِي ٱحْمِلِي ٱلْغُلَامَ وَشُدِّي يَدَكِ بِهِ، لِأَنِّي سَأَجْعَلُهُ أُمَّةً عَظِيمَةً».
verses.kjv: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
verses.web: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

verses.ar: وَفَتَحَ ٱللهُ عَيْنَيْهَا فَأَبْصَرَتْ بِئْرَ مَاءٍ، فَذَهَبَتْ وَمَلَأَتِ ٱلْقِرْبَةَ مَاءً وَسَقَتِ ٱلْغُلَامَ.
verses.kjv: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
verses.web: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ ٱللهُ مَعَ ٱلْغُلَامِ فَكَبِرَ، وَسَكَنَ فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ، وَكَانَ يَنْمُو رَامِيَ قَوْسٍ.
verses.kjv: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
verses.web: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.

verses.ar: وَسَكَنَ فِي بَرِّيَّةِ فَارَانَ، وَأَخَذَتْ لَهُ أُمُّهُ زَوْجَةً مِنْ أَرْضِ مِصْرَ.
verses.kjv: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
verses.web: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

verses.ar: وَحَدَثَ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلزَّمَانِ أَنَّ أَبِيمَالِكَ وَفِيكُولَ رَئِيسَ جَيْشِهِ كَلَّمَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَائِلَيْنِ: «ٱللهُ مَعَكَ فِي كُلِّ مَا أَنْتَ صَانِعٌ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God [is] with thee in all that thou doest:
verses.web: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

verses.ar: فَٱلْآنَ ٱحْلِفْ لِي بِٱللهِ هَهُنَا أَنَّكَ لَا تَغْدُرُ بِي وَلَا بِنَسْلِي وَذُرِّيَّتِي، كَٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ٱلَّذِي صَنَعْتُ إِلَيْكَ تَصْنَعُ إِلَيَّ وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي تَغَرَّبْتَ فِيهَا».
verses.kjv: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son: [but] according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
verses.web: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: «أَنَا أَحْلِفُ».
verses.kjv: And Abraham said, I will swear.
verses.web: Abraham said, “I will swear.”

verses.ar: وَعَاتَبَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَبِيمَالِكَ لِسَبَبِ بِئْرِ ٱلْمَاءِ ٱلَّتِي ٱغْتَصَبَهَا عَبِيدُ أَبِيمَالِكَ.
verses.kjv: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
verses.web: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ أَبِيمَالِكُ: «لَمْ أَعْلَمْ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا ٱلْأَمْرَ. أَنْتَ لَمْ تُخْبِرْنِي، وَلَا أَنَا سَمِعْتُ سِوَى ٱلْيَوْمِ».
verses.kjv: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I [of it], but to day.
verses.web: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ غَنَمًا وَبَقَرًا وَأَعْطَى أَبِيمَالِكَ، فَقَطَعَا كِلَاهُمَا مِيثَاقًا.
verses.kjv: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
verses.web: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

verses.ar: وَأَقَامَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ سَبْعَ نِعَاجٍ مِنَ ٱلْغَنَمِ وَحْدَهَا.
verses.kjv: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.web: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ أَبِيمَالِكُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ: «مَا هِيَ هَذِهِ ٱلسَّبْعُ ٱلنِّعَاجِ ٱلَّتِي أَقَمْتَهَا وَحْدَهَا؟»
verses.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What [mean] these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
verses.web: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ: «إِنَّكَ سَبْعَ نِعَاجٍ تَأْخُذُ مِنْ يَدِي، لِكَيْ تَكُونَ لِي شَهَادَةً بِأَنِّي حَفَرْتُ هَذِهِ ٱلْبِئْرَ».
verses.kjv: And he said, For [these] seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
verses.web: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ دَعَا ذَلِكَ ٱلْمَوْضِعَ «بِئْرَ سَبْعٍ»، لِأَنَّهُمَا هُنَاكَ حَلَفَا كِلَاهُمَا.
verses.kjv: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.
verses.web: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.

verses.ar: فَقَطَعَا مِيثَاقًا فِي بِئْرِ سَبْعٍ، ثُمَّ قَامَ أَبِيمَالِكُ وَفِيكُولُ رَئِيسُ جَيْشِهِ وَرَجَعَا إِلَى أَرْضِ ٱلْفِلِسْطِينِيِّينَ.
verses.kjv: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
verses.web: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

verses.ar: وَغَرَسَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَثْلًا فِي بِئْرِ سَبْعٍ، وَدَعَا هُنَاكَ بِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ ٱلْإِلَهِ ٱلسَّرْمَدِيِّ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And [Abraham] planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.
verses.web: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.

verses.ar: وَتَغَرَّبَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ فِي أَرْضِ ٱلْفِلِسْطِينِيِّينَ أَيَّامًا كَثِيرَةً.
verses.kjv: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines’ land many days.
verses.web: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.
